direct_regions.about: Direct-radio regions (CONTRACT_direct_regions.md). rule_set is the DirectRegion id; 0 is no region. Reasons, how-codes and classes are names, or (in sweep rows) indexes into direct_regions.reasons / convert_how. 'device' names a profile of direct_regions.devices or is {gain_cdbi, min_dbm, max_dbm}. The synthetic section's rule set exists only here.
